protocol.gamma_scope: Preserved planner parameter; this is a conditional singular-request qualification, no planner Bernoulli events.
protocol.random_stream: Python random.Random(seed), separate seed streams. Per request: one random()<0.5 selects s, held for all retries. Each construction draws all6 uniform source-limit angles then sets q5=0. After all8 roots/arm, one random() chooses uniformly from ascending source-bound-legal roots, for arm1 then other arm. No root replacement after collision.
protocol.ik_branches_per_construct: All8 for arm1 and all8 for other passive arm, even if either list is empty; no designated-arm IK/re-solving.
protocol.root_policy: Original0..7 numbered, source-accepted finite source-bound-legal roots. Every accepted root must independently round-trip; a soundness failure stops the run. Duplicated roots retain their source branch multiplicity.
protocol.collision_qualification_scope: Qualified original discrete source pair/mesh/tolerance policy only; complete physical geometry, omitted pairs and CCD remain unverified.
protocol.collision_checker_contract: stdin one JSON line {environment:VI,q:[18 angles]}; stdout exactly one JSON object with status and collision bool/null. Only actual qualified original-PQP call with collision=false can qualify.
protocol.positive_coverage_gate: At least one fully closure/bounds/rank/collision-qualified candidate with each designated passive arm2/3. Request failures remain failures; this gate is not RSS/RBS/planning PASS.
protocol.q2_branch_bridge: NOT_IMPLEMENTED_NOT_EXECUTED; no global RSS success claim
protocol.no_reset_policy: Atomic fixed authorization claim; this runner refuses any second launch, including after crash. Claim is not a claim that all960 were used. Preserve prefix and actual remaining; an evidenced correction may continue within those remaining limits only under a new frozen continuation protocol/source, without resetting the original authorization.
